about: Fifteen bento section layouts as grid specs. Every number was measured at a 1440 viewport (css px) on the sites named in `measured`; `range` is the band across measured sites; values marked (screenshot) were read from the 2x capture, not from the DOM. Rules: knowledge/web/bento.md (BE-01..32) and knowledge/web/bento-craft.md. Cell visuals: system/sections/bento-cells.md (C01..C28). Pick the layout from the claim count (BE-01), then bind radius, gap and shell to the house system (BE-08..11). Founder rules in knowledge/founder/founder-taste.md outrank everything here (no grey stage boxes, equal tile heights on tablet and phone, identical bentos across sibling pages).

conventions.container: 1200-1312 wide at 1440 (Stripe 1245, Ramp 1312, Notion 1229, Supabase 1280, Clerk 1200); narrow grids 980-1080 (Apple MBP 980, Spline 1080, Apple upgrade 1050)
conventions.spans: colSpan/rowSpan are on the layout's own column grid; rows sum exactly to the container width; tall = 2 x short + gap
conventions.mobile_default: 1 column, equal heights per tier, 16-24 side gutter, same radius; crop visuals rather than scale (BE-29, BE-30)

layouts.name: Uniform spec grid 3x2
layouts.use_when: 6 parallel specs or upgrade reasons of equal weight, each one fact; hardware, plans, performance claims

apple-iphone-18-pro.fill: #000 tiles inside a lighter rounded panel (about 36 radius, screenshot)
apple-iphone-18-pro.title: 19/600 +0.228px rgba(255,255,255,.56), centred
apple-iphone-18-pro.control: compare selector top-right re-fills all tiles

layouts.rhythm: alternate figure tiles (max 1/3) with render tiles; no two figure tiles share an edge (Apple: diagonal, end of row 1 and start of row 2) (BE-17)
layouts.avoid: all six tiles as figures; UI fragments in a centred spec grid

layouts.name: Offset masonry 2-col (photo headline tiles)
layouts.use_when: 4 big headline claims backed by photography; consumer hardware, creative tools

grid.template: two flex columns, each a stack of tall + short tiles in opposite order

apple-macbook-pro.heights: col A 401 then 241; col B 241 then 401 (variants 380/230)
apple-macbook-pro.title: 40/600 (tall) or 28/600 (short) #f5f5f7, no body

layouts.avoid: masonry with UI fragments (ragged crops); more than 2 columns

layouts.name: 2 over 3
layouts.use_when: 5 claims under one platform theme; 2 core workflows on top, 3 supporting below

ramp.title: 24/400 two-tone sentence, 39-50 chars, no body
ramp.affordance: 16px arrow in about 32px button top-right, transform on hover

layouts.avoid: same visual type in the two lead tiles; a body paragraph under sentence titles

layouts.name: Two-thirds lead, three, full
layouts.use_when: 6 product lines or capabilities with one flagship; payments, platforms

stripe.gap: about 5 in the DOM; about 14 visible at rest because each tile is clip-path inset 4px
stripe.title: about 22/400 top-left (screenshot)
stripe.field: brand ribbon gradient bleeding from one corner
stripe.hover: clip-path inset(4px 4.83px round 6px) -> inset(0 round 6px) 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1); gradient border opacity 0->1 0.25s; title translate(-4.8px,-4px) 0.8s; icon arrows +-2px 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)

layouts.avoid: gradient field in every tile (keep to 30-60%); soft radius with this tight gap

layouts.name: 2 + full-wide + catalogue strip
layouts.use_when: 3 headline capabilities plus 4-6 use cases or templates

notion.copy: eyebrow ('Capture knowledge') + 22/700 -0.25px title + 32px round black arrow; catalogue 16/700 two-line label with arrow, 40px illustrated icon
notion.visual: white app window inset 24-32px bleeding off the bottom, plus a floating overlay (recording pill, ask bar)

layouts.avoid: catalogue cards with visuals; wide tile with copy centred

layouts.name: Brick (alternating offset)
layouts.use_when: 4 capabilities of equal weight that need movement without a fake hierarchy; creative and 3D tools

spline.title: 20/500 rgba(255,255,255,.9)
spline.visual: 3D object video on an isometric floor grid, bottom-right; one canvas 598x520 bleeding right and bottom

layouts.avoid: brick with 5+ tiles (reads ragged); mirrored rows with different heights

layouts.name: 12-col lead plus small
layouts.use_when: a platform with one primary product and 4-6 modules

layouts.name: 3-col with tall spans
layouts.use_when: 7-9 security or platform features of mixed depth; dark technical brands

layouts.name: 2x2 (tiles or media-caption)
layouts.use_when: 4 equal claims; media-caption variant for editorial or finance brands

mercury.stage: warm grey with grain and depth-of-field blur, purple light
mercury.caption: below the media, 18/480 title + 18/360 body, same size

media-caption.founder_note: a grey stage needs an override in DIRECTION.md (founder: no grey stage boxes)

layouts.name: Full-width lead plus 2
layouts.use_when: one flagship capability plus 2 companions; AI and app launches

layouts.name: Hairline grid / triptych
layouts.use_when: engineered or dark brands; principles, platform pillars, 3-9 features drawn as line art or tight UI

grid.template: repeat(3, 1fr); gap 0; 1px dividers or 1px dashed cells

linear-fig.columns: 3 at about 426 pitch, text at x 80/539/965
linear-fig.label: FIG 0.N 12/400 Berkeley Mono #8a8f98 at top
linear-fig.title: 15/510 -0.165px #d0d6e0
linear-fig.heading: 48/510 -1.056px two-tone (#f7f8f8 lead, #8a8f98 continuation)

plain-dark.visual: icon or chip clusters with dashed empty slots

dub.rails: 1px vertical page rails at the container edges; full-width 1px section rules

layouts.avoid: hairlines plus tile fills (double structure); dividers that cross the drawings (founder rail rule)

layouts.name: Wide plus 3 small, text in the slot
layouts.use_when: one headline capability with 3 sub-capabilities; the headline copy sits in the empty slot beside the wide visual

grid.template: repeat(3, 1fr) / 480px 220px; wide spans 2 cols; copy occupies col 3 row 1

cells.name: slot-copy
cells.copy: eyebrow chip + 48-56px headline + body + mono CTA

layouts.name: Uniform 2-up / 3-up feature cards
layouts.use_when: 2-3 equal claims, each with its own visual; the most common 2026 bento

lovable.title: 16/600 at bottom
lovable.visual: UI top, cropped right, radial colour halo mask behind it

mobile.equal_heights: Lovable, Resend yes; Cursor content height (less tidy)

layouts.avoid: three tiles with the same visual type; icon-only visuals (that is a feature list, not a bento)

layouts.name: Icon catalogue
layouts.use_when: 5-8 small extras after the main bento ('and so much more')

layouts.name: Sequenced alternatives (when a grid would be too many cells)
layouts.use_when: 8+ deep features, or one feature that needs a full-width scene

measured.dub: funnel stage above 3 tabs; active tab 1px green left rule, inactive about 40% opacity
measured.lovable: sticky tab list left (active gradient underline), 880x500 radius 12 dark panels right with a bottom pastel glow
measured.posthog: tabbed window, active tab filled in brand magenta

measured.retool: sticky headline + accordion left; stacked radius-24 cards right, active card pastel gradient, inactive dimmed grey

measured.lindy: 01/02/03 list left (inactive about 40%), one sticky visual card right with corner gradient

measured.linear-intake: 480x559 chat panel overlapping a kanban that fades into the page; feature links in 2 columns with a hairline divider

measured.granola: hairline topic rows (serif 32/400 left, 22/400 right) over 1280x527 photo plates split 900+443, square corners

mobile.tabs: become stacked panels with inline titles
